acceptanceCriteria: No cargo build/run or workspace binary fallback; old and new public archives are tag-bound and checksum-verified; isolated HOME/XDG/TMP/adopter; old schema reports MIGRATION_REQUIRED under new Runtime; plan is read-only; unapproved apply fails; approved apply records runtime-bound receipt; historical evidence is byte-identical; new Runtime reaches COMPATIBLE and continues Work Item/Agent/verify operation; acceptance.json and SHA256SUMS are produced; failed post-release acceptance never mutates Release truth.
authority: repository owner approval required for published-artifact upgrade acceptance
goal: Prove an old adopter can upgrade from the previous public Runtime through explicit compatibility, reviewed migration, preserved evidence, and continued governed operation.
intent: Add a reproducible post-release N-1 adopter upgrade acceptance harness using only immutable public Release artifacts.
